attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Michigan corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Michigan Corporate Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto false result.mi_has_nexus xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts)
condition_details.condition_description: result.mi_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.mi_economic_nexus_threshold

action_details.action_postfix: // No nexus - no filing required false result.mi_has_nexus xdef 0.0 result.mi_tax_liability xdef "Michigan filing not required: No nexus with state" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Michigan state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. MI requires addback of federal bond interest, IRC 199A, bonus depreciation. MI allows MI municipal bond interest subtraction.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Michigan Corporate Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.mi_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.mi_state_subtractions xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Michigan state additions and subtractions

action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 result.mi_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.mi_state_subtractions xdef "Michigan adjustments not calculated: No nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Michigan corporate income tax. Applies Michigan flat rate (6.0%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Michigan Corporate Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.mi_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.mi_tax_liability xdef

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: // No taxable income - no tax liability 0.0 result.mi_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.mi_tax_liability xdef result.mi_estimated_payments result.mi_refund_or_owed xdef "Michigan tax liability: $0 (no taxable income)" job.audit_trail swap addto

// No nexus - no tax liability 0.0 result.mi_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.mi_tax_liability xdef result.mi_estimated_payments result.mi_refund_or_owed xdef "Michigan tax liability: $0 (no nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto
